members.name: Calendar
members.doc: Base calendar class. This class doesn't do any formatting. It simply provides data to subclasses.

members.name: calendar
members.doc: Returns a year's calendar as a multi-line string.

members.name: Day
members.doc: Enum where members are also (and must be) ints

members.name: error
members.doc: Inappropriate argument value (of correct type).

members.name: format
members.doc: Prints multi-column formatting for year calendars

members.name: formatstring
members.doc: Returns a string formatted from n strings, centered within n columns.

members.name: global_enum
members.doc: decorator that makes the repr() of an enum member reference its module instead of its class; also exports all members to the enum's module's global namespace

members.name: HTMLCalendar
members.doc: This calendar returns complete HTML pages.

members.name: IllegalMonthError
members.doc: Inappropriate argument value (of correct type).

members.name: IllegalWeekdayError
members.doc: Inappropriate argument value (of correct type).

members.name: IntEnum
members.signature: (new_class_name, /, names, *, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)
members.doc: Enum where members are also (and must be) ints

members.name: isleap
members.doc: Return True for leap years, False for non-leap years.

members.name: leapdays
members.doc: Return number of leap years in range [y1, y2). Assume y1 <= y2.

members.name: LocaleHTMLCalendar
members.doc: This class can be passed a locale name in the constructor and will return month and weekday names in the specified locale.

members.name: LocaleTextCalendar
members.doc: This class can be passed a locale name in the constructor and will return month and weekday names in the specified locale.

members.name: Month
members.doc: Enum where members are also (and must be) ints

members.name: month
members.doc: Return a month's calendar string (multi-line).

members.name: monthcalendar
members.doc: Return a matrix representing a month's calendar. Each row represents a week; days outside this month are zero.

members.name: monthrange
members.doc: Return weekday of first day of month (0-6 ~ Mon-Sun) and number of days (28-31) for year, month.

members.name: prcal
members.doc: Print a year's calendar.

members.name: prmonth
members.doc: Print a month's calendar.

members.name: prweek
members.doc: Print a single week (no newline).

members.name: repeat
members.doc: repeat(object [,times]) -> create an iterator which returns the object for the specified number of times. If not specified, returns the object endlessly.

members.name: TextCalendar
members.doc: Subclass of Calendar that outputs a calendar as a simple plain text similar to the UNIX program cal.

members.name: timegm
members.doc: Unrelated but handy function to calculate Unix timestamp from GMT.

members.name: week
members.doc: Returns a single week in a string (no newline).

members.name: weekday
members.doc: Return weekday (0-6 ~ Mon-Sun) for year, month (1-12), day (1-31).

members.name: weekheader
members.doc: Return a header for a week.
